author: danceratopz
content:
🐻‍❄️ New mainnet test release: `tests@v21.0.3`

This is a [patch release](https://specs.ethereum.foundation/docs/execution-specs/running_tests/releases/#versioning-scheme): no consensus changes, mainly new coverage!

🔀 New `consume-reorg` simulator: reorg tests from geth, Erigon, Nethermind & reth plus all of hive's `reorg.go` scenarios are now in one execution-specs suite ([#3556](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3556), [#4032](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/4032)) <@703742742135570499>

📡 `consume-wirex` ships: EngineX fixtures via each client's devp2p full sync ([#3365](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3365)) <@547171287831805972>

🌳 More MPT cases, including the reth state root bug family ([#3964](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3964), [#3984](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3984)) <@703742742135570499><@547171287831805972>

⚡ Faster `consume-enginex` and `consume-wirex` ([#3914](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3914), [#3919](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3919), [#3952](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3952)) <@547171287831805972>

🛠️ Fixes for client failures on the mainnet hive dashboard:
- EIP-155 chain ids over 64 bits now also accept `INVALID_CHAINID` ([#3935](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3935)) <@1035282811847987270> 
- EIP-8282: the BAL lists the empty system contract ([#3929](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3929)) <@628018527470616606> 
- `consume-rlp` DAO fork ordering for geth ([#3980](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3980)) and besu, erigon and reth exception mappings <@547171287831805972>

🆕 Also: forged BALs at the item cap ([#3944](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3944)) <@796570016966770688>

PTAL at the [release notes](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v21.0.3) for the full list!
